test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

My mother will bake two dozen cookies for the bake sale.

options.text: Two dozen cookies shall be baked by my mother for the bake sale.
Two dozen cookies will be baked by my mother for the bake sale.
Two dozen cookies will baked by my mother for the bake sale.
Two dozen cookies will have been baked by my mother for the bake sale.

solution:
The correct answer: *Two dozen cookies will be baked by my mother for the bake sale*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Given sentence: **My mother will bake two dozen cookies for the bake sale. ** 
 
• The above sentence belongs to **Simple Future Tense (Subject+shall/will+base verb+object).**
 
• The rule for changing the voice: **Object+shall/will +be+ past participle of base verb+by+object.**
 
• In the sentence, the **subject** is: **My mother**, the** object **is** Two dozen cookies and **the **base verb **is** bake.**
 
• The options except (2) don’t follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.
 
• Thus the **correct answer** is: ***Two dozen cookies will be baked by my mother for the bake sale***.
